plugins.name: deck-kit
plugins.description: Branded presentation deck toolkit. Ships three skills: deck-brand-init (brand.yaml scaffolding), deck-create (conversational HTML deck authoring), and deck-publish (HTML to PDF or PPTX via Puppeteer + pptxgenjs, both pixel-perfect screenshot and fully-editable modes). Works in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI.
